data.idle_off_minutes: Show OFF after this many minutes without heating (0 = never)
data.temperature_maintenance: Press UP/DOWN automatically to hold the target
data.power_usage: Power sensor of the heater's plug

data_description.power_threshold: Readings below this are not heating. Keep it above the small draw the heater has while winding down after OFF (about 21 W).
data_description.idle_off_minutes: The heater pauses on its own thermostat for up to ~20 minutes, and the plug reads 0 W then. Longer than this with no heating means it was switched off outside Home Assistant.
data_description.mode_button: The remote button that steps the heater's mode (for example low heat, high heat, fan only). With it you can choose fan only; the plug tells fan (about 10-60 W, steady) from heating.
data_description.power_usage: Must read real watts (check it shows about 20 W on fan / 1000-2000 W heating).
